verification.method: Compare source departure minutes and destinations against current official JR station timetables for both directions and weekday/SaturdayHoliday. Includes Takasaki/Utsunomiya only, excluding Joban and limited express. Override holiday train1881E base using official detailed timetable; apply four date override groups for three trains.
verification.edition: JR timetable November2026, currently linked from official station indexes on2026-10-25; not a valid-from-Nov1 assumption
verification.arrivalVerification: Most station arrival values sourced from MIT Mini Tokyo3D, not individually official-reverified; corrected/exception records individually verified in official train pages.

rideStops.scope: 승차역부터 하차역까지 해당 열차가 실제 정차하는 역만 연결. 원본 nt 연결로 동일 차량의 직통·순환 구간을 이어 붙임.
rideStops.timeFields: arrival와 departure는 원문에서 제공하는 필드만 사용. 좌표는 원본 stations.json의 경위도를 위도·경도 순으로 변환.
